title: The mirror, reframed
logline: A mirror the shop framed in 2003, in a hallway in 2024, and in it the hallway's end and a coat hook, and no one. The frame's corner chipped where it was moved. The page draws a mirror with nothing to reflect, on purpose.

panels.composition: A framed mirror on a hallway wall reflecting the hallway's far end and an empty coat hook, the frame's lower corner chipped, a strip of daylight from a door out of frame.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a framed mirror on a hallway wall reflecting the hallway's far end and an empty coat hook, the frame's lower corner chipped, a strip of daylight from an unseen door, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
